Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the CNRS page’s “professor at Université de la Méditerranée since 2007” as conflicting with the Berggruen page’s “professor at CPT Marseille since 2000.” These refer to different appointments in France (CPT in 2000 and university post in 2007), which are complementary, not contradictory. This conflation led to a perceived conflict instead of recognizing 2000 as the start of working in France and using 2007 as a later role.
